issuer: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's licensing authority (the Transport Department's driving licence services, through the Dastak app)
note: Read 2026-10-30. Pakistan's licences are issued by each province and territory, so Pakistan is kept by its regions; this is Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's. The Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's own text, as the Law Department's KP Code publishes it (with amendments by Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Acts to XXVI of 2025): no one may drive a motor car, otherwise than as a paid employee, until 18 (s. 4(1)(ii)); a licence is effective without renewal for up to five years, three years or one year, as the applicant opts (s. 11, substituted by KP Ord. XVII of 2002). The fees are 'as prescribed' and the prescribed fee for each term wasn't read, so the three terms can't be written (a term needs its fee): validYears and fee are null. The issuer is read from the Transport Department's own site, whose Driving License page offers, through the Dastak app, learner permits, new permanent licences, renewals and duplicates; the Ordinance names only 'the licensing authority'.
